name: Kaori Takamachi
source:
Front-end Programmer

Kaori had been in and out of work since she graduated, always feeling uncomfortable in the various work environments. She finally found her place at Hasou Web Solutions where she excels as a front-end programmer. She is insecure about her childish appearance and has a borderline obsession with being ladylike. She is easily irritated and quickly loses her patience with people. She tries to hide her weakness for cute things, but isn't very good at doing so.

"Please treat me like the first-class lady that I am."
